_comment: PR-4 example: MCC_ATTESTATION_TRUST_CONFIG holds ONLY the Independent Attester Service's Ed25519 PUBLIC key -- the gateway never sees, loads, or needs its private key. Generate the Attester's key pair with scripts/generate_signing_key.py (run on the Attester side only); publish the printed public key here with scripts/build_attester_trust_config.py. Rotate by adding a new kid entry, then removing the old one once rotation is complete.
